author: FOX10News
title: Goodwill Gulf Coast to host 37th annual golf tournament
text:
The tournament brings together local business and community leaders for a day of golf that supports Goodwill’s mission of service.
) - Goodwill Gulf Coast will host its 37th annual Greer’s and Goodwill Gulf Coast Golf Tournament on Thursday at Magnolia Grove Golf Course in Mobile .
Sponsored by Greer’s Markets, the tournament brings together local business and community leaders for a day of golf that supports Goodwill’s mission of service. Proceeds help fund Goodwill Gulf Coast programs that provide education, job skills training, early childhood development and employment opportunities for people in need.
